data_objects.name: municipal_department_budget_periods
data_objects.meaning: Municipal department identifiers, organizational groups, and associated budget-year date boundaries.

variables.name: Department Name
variables.meaning: Official or display name of the department.

variables.name: github-dept-code
variables.meaning: Short source department code labeled github-dept-code.

variables.name: dept_group
variables.meaning: Higher-level organizational or service grouping for the department.

variables.name: budget_year_start
variables.meaning: Start date of the department's budget-year period.

variables.name: budget_year_end
variables.meaning: End date of the department's budget-year period.

structure.description: Each row associates one department and its source codes with one budget-year interval and department group.

uncertainties: The expansions and governance of the coa_dept_id and github-dept-code coding systems are not provided.
The table does not explicitly state whether the interval endpoints are inclusive.
annotation_notes: Identifiers and groupings are described using only the source labels and values.
